title: Swapping Nodes in a Linked List
sourceKind: official-page-blocked; statement and examples from WebSearch result summaries citing leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/1721/ and mirrors
summary: Given the head of a linked list and k (1-based), swap the values of the k-th node from the start and the k-th node from the end. Return the head.
officialConstraints: The list has n nodes; 1 <= k <= n <= 10^5; 0 <= Node.val <= 100.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps the list at 30 nodes (LeetCode allows 10^5).
